

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The title changed from “Cyborg Commander’s Lightsabers” to “Grievous’ Lightsabers”, and “Deploy on Cyborg Commander” became “Deploy on Grievous”. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Cyborg Commander's Lightsabers (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state.
